customManagers.description: Pins annotated with a `# renovate: ...` comment on the line above. Form 1: KEY=value (versions.env), ARG KEY=value (Containerfile), key := "value" (Justfile). The value must look like a version (v?digit...) so this does not misfire on form 2.

packageRules.description: The dockerfile manager sees FROM alpine as docker.io/alpine while the annotated pins use bare `alpine`; group them so versions.env, Justfile fallbacks, and every Containerfile ARG default bump in one PR.
App version bumps are never automerge candidates: a human reads the changelog before merging, and deploys stay manual (`just deploy <target>`).
